summary: Decomposition Engine reform — backend 31/31 pytest PASS, frontend live flows PASS. Verified against https://personal-os-app-8.preview.emergentagent.com as test@hymn.app. BACKEND: (a) POST /api/auth/login → 200 + bearer access_token. (b) All 10 old planning routes (analyze/confirm/generate/approve/reject/pause/select-tradeoff/reassess/proposals/proposals/{id}) return 404 on both GET+POST, and all 3 old knowledge routes (journeys/stages/components) return 404 on GET/POST/PUT/DELETE. (c) GET /api/planning/goal/{gid}/conversation returns {id, target_type='goal', target_id, messages: []} for an owned goal; second call returns SAME conversation id (idempotent upsert enforced by the (user_id, target_type, target_id) unique index). (d) GET /api/planning/goal/<unknown-uuid>/conversation → 404, GET /api/planning/badtype/<gid>/conversation → 400. (e) POST /api/planning/goal/{gid}/messages with 'Suggest 3 concrete next tasks for this goal.' returns 200 in ~10-20s with the full conversation, both the new user message AND an assistant message appended; the assistant message.content is stripped of <<<HYMN_PROPOSAL>>>/<<<END>>> delimiters (verified across all messages in the response) and message.proposal is a dict when the LLM emits changes. (f) POST /api/planning/conversations/{cid}/materialize with a proposal-bearing message_id → 200 with result.created_outcomes[] and result.created_tasks[]; a second call with the same message_id → 400 'already applied'; call with a user-message id (no proposal) → 400. (g) Atomicity: created tasks are retrievable via GET /api/tasks?goal_id=<gid>, each has a non-null expected_outcome_id (attached to the matched or newly-created outcome). (h) POST /api/planning/goal/{gid}/reset returns a fresh empty conversation ({messages: []}). (i) journey_type persisted on Goal create (POST /api/goals with journey_type='certification' → 201, returned in GoalResponse; PUT /api/goals/{id} with journey_type='language' updates + GET reflects). (j) GET /api/tasks?project_id=<pid> filters correctly (task must be created with origin='project' to persist project_id — required by _validate_task_origin); GET /api/checkins?project_id=<pid> filters correctly; GET /api/checkins?goal_id=<gid> still works. FRONTEND (mobile 390×844): (1) Sign-in flow (test@hymn.app / TestPass123!) via sign-in-email-input / sign-in-password-input / sign-in-submit-button lands on /today. (2) Knowledge tab (data-testid='tab-knowledge') shows 5 goals filtered by domain_name==='Knowledge' (Guitar/Chess/Master Kubernetes/TEST_UI_Goal_K/Learn Python); each card has data-testid='journey-row-{id}'. Journey_type labels ('SKILL', 'LEARNING JOURNEY') render at the top-left of each card. Tapping Guitar navigates to /goals/2b6caf8a…. (3) On the Goal detail screen, tapping 'goal-detail-plan-btn' navigates to /planning/goal/{gid} — the chat exposes planning-back, planning-reset, planning-input, planning-send. When the conversation was empty, 4 opener chips rendered (Help me break this down…, What am I missing…, Suggest 5 concrete next tasks, How should I sequence…). (4) Sending 'Propose 2 outcomes and 3 tasks for learning guitar chords. Include HYMN_PROPOSAL.' surfaces a warm assistant reply within ~14-18s AND a 'Proposed changes' card (testID planning-proposal-{msg_id}) with 2 outcomes + 3 tasks + 'Cadence → weekly' + a green 'Apply these changes' button (testID planning-apply-{msg_id}). No raw HYMN_PROPOSAL delimiters leaked into the visible text. (5) Tapping Apply materialised the proposal — card switched to a green checkmark row reading 'Added 2 outcomes and 3 tasks.' and the same button disappeared (cannot be re-tapped). (6) Back on the Goal detail, the newly-added Expected Outcomes ('Master open chord shapes', 'Smooth chord transitions at tempo') appear under EXPECTED OUTCOMES and the 3 new tasks appear under NO DUE DATE section (correct since the LLM proposal didn't include due_dates). Sticky section header 'NO DUE DATE' with count '8' rendered on the goal detail. (7) Long-press-and-hold on a task-row-{id} for ~1s activates bulk-select — action bar (testID 'task-actionbar') shows '1 selected' and 4 pill buttons: Reschedule / Complete / Archive / Delete (all with testIDs task-action-*). (8) Tapping Reschedule opens a modal with all four presets (reschedule-tomorrow, reschedule-week, reschedule-month) + reschedule-custom-input (YYYY-MM-DD) + reschedule-confirm / reschedule-cancel. Custom '2026-12-31' + Confirm updates the tasks and exits bulk mode. (9) The 'Plan with Hymn' button on Project detail (testID 'project-detail-plan-btn') opens the SAME /planning/project/{pid} chat UI with all 4 testIDs (back/reset/input/send) — the empty-state prompt correctly says 'Tell me what you want to accomplish, what's already tried, or what's blocking you. I can propose outcomes, tasks and cadences and apply them straight to this Project.' (Project-aware phrasing). LLM model in code is anthropic 'claude-sonnet-4-6' (Claude Sonnet 4.5) with the web_search_20250305 provider-hosted tool at max_uses=3. Migration was destructive per plan; existing 5 Knowledge-domain goals surface via listGoals (no residual /api/knowledge/* routes). No deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) referenced anywhere. No SafeAreaView from 'react-native' — all four touched screens import from react-native-safe-area-context. No React Native red-screen. No console errors surfaced beyond harmless 'shadow*' / pointerEvents deprecation warnings.

issues: Long-press-to-enter-bulk-select is currently the ONLY way to activate multi-select on tasks. On desktop web preview via Playwright, holding mouse.down for 1000-1200ms activates it ~60-70% of the time; the RN Pressable delayLongPress default is 500ms but occasionally the pointerup fires before the timer. On real mobile (touch events with pointerType=touch) this is reliable, but consider surfacing a visible affordance (e.g. a 'Select' icon in the task section header) for accessibility on tablets/desktop-web.

action_items: (Nice-to-have UX) Add a visible multi-select toggle to the task section header — long-press on desktop-web is flaky and not discoverable. Existing long-press behaviour is fine for real mobile.
(Nice-to-have) Consider surfacing a lightweight assistant status like 'Searching the web…' when the web_search tool is actually being invoked, so users understand the 15-30s latency.
critical_code_review_comments: planning_engine.py:207-226 — _PROPOSAL_RE is non-greedy and re.DOTALL, and _split_message calls _PROPOSAL_RE.sub('', raw) so prose is stripped cleanly even if the model puts extra whitespace after <<<END>>>. Confirmed no delimiter leakage in 3 live LLM turns.

planning_engine.py:319-347 — _get_or_create_conversation is upsert-safe: it does a find_one first, and the unique compound index on (user_id, target_type, target_id) prevents a race from creating duplicates. Idempotency test PASS.

planning_engine.py:388-520 — _materialize_proposal builds outcome_id_by_title case-insensitive lookup then falls back to next(iter(outcome_id_by_title.values())) so goal-task attachment is always deterministic. The compensating try/except deletes created outcomes+tasks on any downstream failure. `materialized_at` is stamped on the message before save, making a second materialize call cleanly 400.
planning_engine.py:290 — model id 'claude-sonnet-4-6' — appears correct for Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations (per the request note); live turns return in 10-20s.

server.py:1148-1189 — /api/tasks list query correctly ORs expected_outcome_id (via eo_ids) OR component_id when both goal_id and component_id are supplied, otherwise applies the direct project_id/component_id filter. project_id filter verified live.

server.py:1206-1230 — POST /api/tasks intentionally NULLS project_id when origin != 'project' (line 1216) and NULLS expected_outcome_id when origin != 'expected_outcome' (line 1215). Callers (including planning materialization) correctly set origin='project' for project tasks — see planning_engine.py:465-466. This is by-design invariant, not a bug; noted here so future testing agents don't rediscover it.
TaskListWithGrouping.tsx:165 — bulk-select entry is only bound to onLongPress. That's discoverable on mobile but not on web. See action item.
planning/[targetType]/[targetId].tsx:13, goals/[id].tsx:3, projects/[id].tsx:3, (tabs)/knowledge.tsx:3 — SafeAreaView imported from react-native-safe-area-context (correct).

planning/[targetType]/[targetId].tsx:269-314 — Proposed-changes card renders proposal.expected_outcomes / .tasks / .checkin_cadence in a compact list, testIDs planning-proposal-{msg_id} + planning-apply-{msg_id} — matches spec.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_planning_reform.py (new — 31 pytest cases covering auth, removed old planning + knowledge routes, journey_type on Goal create/update, conversation lifecycle, live-LLM message + materialize + idempotency, tasks/checkins project_id filter)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of primary flows verified (sign-in, Knowledge tab list, Goal detail → chat, message → proposal card, apply → materialise + green indicator, task section rendering, bulk-select action bar + Reschedule modal + presets/custom, Project detail Plan-with-Hymn opens same chat UI)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest creates TEST_planning_journey_*, TEST_planning_llm_*, TEST_filter_project_*, TEST_filter_task, TEST_filter_checkin and cleans them up via DELETE in per-class teardown tests. Frontend live testing left ONE Guitar Goal enriched with 2 new expected outcomes ('Master open chord shapes', 'Smooth chord transitions at tempo') + 3 new tasks (Learn Big 5 chords, Drill chord transitions, Apply chords) under test@hymn.app — the tasks are attached to the correct outcomes. Reschedule test bumped 1 task's due_date to 2026-12-31. Also 1 Project (TEST_UI_project_planning) was created and deleted inline during the project-mode chat test. No shared/seeded production data was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New conversational planning API is stable. Route shape: GET/POST /api/planning/{target_type}/{target_id}/conversation|messages|reset (target_type ∈ {goal, project}), plus POST /api/planning/conversations/{conversation_id}/materialize {message_id}. Assistant messages include .proposal (dict|null) and, after apply, .materialized_at + .materialized_summary. The old /api/planning/analyze,confirm,generate,approve,reject,pause,select-tradeoff,reassess,proposals[,{id}] endpoints and /api/knowledge/journeys,stages,components CRUD have all been removed and return 404. Live LLM (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations with the web_search_20250305 provider-hosted tool, max_uses=3) typically returns within 10-20s; give it up to 60s under load. To trigger a HYMN_PROPOSAL emission reliably, ask 'Propose N outcomes and M tasks for … Include HYMN_PROPOSAL.' — a bare 'suggest tasks' prompt sometimes gets a discovery reply with no proposal. IMPORTANT: /api/tasks intentionally nulls project_id unless origin='project' is sent — always include origin when creating project tasks in tests. Frontend testIDs: tab-knowledge, journey-row-{id}, goal-detail-plan-btn, project-detail-plan-btn, planning-back, planning-reset, planning-input, planning-send, planning-opener-<prefix>, planning-proposal-{msg_id}, planning-apply-{msg_id}, task-row-{id}, task-actionbar, task-action-reschedule / -complete / -archive / -delete, reschedule-tomorrow/-week/-month, reschedule-custom-input, reschedule-confirm/-cancel. Login testIDs: sign-in-email-input, sign-in-password-input, sign-in-submit-button; login response returns access_token (not token). The frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Playwright long-press on Pressable is flaky on web — hold mouse.down for ≥1000ms and retry once if bulk-select doesn't activate.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found in this iteration. The Decomposition Engine reform's backend + frontend all behave to spec on the first pass.
